ui_ellipse.meaning: Drawing tool caption selecting ELLIPSE. Opposite drag points define sorted RectF bounds; shapePath uses Path.addOval. Preview/commit draw that path using current outline/fill style.

ui_ellipse.qualification: Shape ellipse/oval, not punctuation ellipsis, elliptical selection or text effect. Circle is possible with equal bounds but source is not renamed Circle. Label selection alone does not draw; actual pointer gesture commits. No pixel/rendering certification.

ui_polygon.meaning: Caption for multi-vertex POLYGON tool. Points build a line-connected path; closePolygon controls closure. Finish or qualified double-tap applies pending path. Closed mode dispatches POLYGON; open mode dispatches LINE and has no interior fill irrespective of shapeStyle.

ui_polygon.qualification: Keep English tool name Polygon, not silently Polyline or always-closed promise. It is a tool supporting closed/open configuration, not a guarantee every intermediate gesture is a mathematical nondegenerate polygon. Existing Close/Finish polygon controls and hints excluded. No English defect established solely from optional open mode.

ui_rounded_rectangle.meaning: Caption selecting ROUND_RECT. Drag bounds feed Path.addRoundRect with equal x/y radius clamped to0..half the shorter side. Radius option changes document.cornerRadius and invalidates preview; shape can approach ordinary rectangle at zero radius.

ui_rounded_rectangle.qualification: Rounded corners, not rotated rectangle, circle, enclosed/surrounded rectangle or arbitrary quadrilateral. Exact source-product translation presence alone cannot establish idiomatic reading; earlier Rectangle acceptance does not transfer to the full phrase. No new radius/units/hints acceptance.
